window.elsewhere.text: Whisker Academy is open in another window. To play here, click Play here instead.

hub.hello.text: Mew! Hello, Princess! I'm so happy you're here.
hub.hello.prince: Mew! Hello, Prince! I'm so happy you're here.

hub.entrance.text: Your first adventure is the Entrance Quest. Click the path when you're ready.

hub.adventure.text: Ready for today's adventure? Click the path to start.

hub.dressup.text: Want to dress up? Click your princess.
hub.dressup.prince: Want to dress up? Click your prince.

hub.colorin.text: Want to color a picture? Click the crayons.

session.copilot.text: Is a grown-up playing with you today?

session.go.text: When you're ready, click the paw to start!

session.path.text: Here is today's path. Let's walk it one stone at a time.

session.done.text: You walked the whole path today!

warmup.blend.text: Listen to the sounds, and slide them together. Which picture is it?

warmup.isolate.first.text: Listen to the word. What sound do you hear first? Click its letter.

warmup.isolate.middle.text: Listen to the word. What sound do you hear in the middle? Click its letter.

warmup.isolate.last.text: Listen to the word. What sound do you hear last? Click its letter.

warmup.segment.text: Say the word slowly. Click one paw for each sound you say. Then click the check.

warmup.segment.listen.text: Now listen, and watch the paws light up.

warmup.delete.text: Say the word. Then say it again, but leave out the part I take away.

warmup.substitute.text: Say the word. Then change one sound to make a new word.

cards.start.text: Sound cards! Let's show Kitty the sounds you know.

cards.see.text: What sound does this card make? Say it, then click the card to check.

cards.hear.text: Listen to the sound. Which letters make it? Click them.

cards.listen.text: Listen carefully. Which word did you hear?

spell.start.text: Welcome to the Spell Workshop! Let's build some word spells.

spell.count.text: How many sounds do you hear? Click one paw for each sound. Then click the check.

spell.boxes.text: Here is one box for each sound.

spell.build.text: Now build it. Click the letters for each sound, from left to right.

spell.read.text: Now read your word out loud. Then click it to hear it.

spell.next.text: Click the arrow when you are ready.

chapters.pick.text: Pick a page of the story.

spell.trick.text: Poof! Your word spell pops into your trick bag.

spell.charm.text: This word becomes a sparkle charm.

chain.start.text: Change-a-letter spells! Change just one sound each time.

chain.next.text: Now change it to make this word:

chain.box.text: Which sound changes? Click its box.

chain.add.text: This time, a new sound comes in. Click the space where it goes.

chain.drop.text: This time, one sound goes away. Click its box.

charm.start.text: Time for a word charm. This is a word we see in lots of books.

charm.build.text: Let's build it, sound by sound.

charm.heart.text: This part doesn't follow the patterns we know yet. We learn that part by heart.

charm.heart.silent.text: Here, this part is quiet. It makes no sound.

charm.letters.text: Say each letter with me as it lights up.

charm.read.text: Now listen to the whole word, and read it.

charm.done.text: Your new charm joins your charm bracelet!

robot.pick.text: Which one is the real word?

blink.start.text: Kitty's blink game! A word will peek out, then hide. Can you read it?

blink.peek.text: You can peek again any time you like.

story.start.text: Story time! Read each line out loud, and watch your words make magic.

story.side.text: Free-time high jinks! Let's see what your friends are up to.

story.question.again.text: Let's watch it again. Which picture shows what happened?

story.reread.start.text: Let's read a story you already know, to make it smoother.

story.reread.model.text: First, listen to me read it.

story.reread.solo.text: Now you read it, all by yourself.

entrance.welcome.text: Welcome to your first day at Whisker Academy! Every new student takes the Entrance Quest, a walk through the reading gate. Let's see all the spells you already know.

entrance.real.text: Read each word out loud. Take your time.

entrance.nonsense.text: These are magic cat names. They're made up, so sound out each one.

entrance.dictation.text: Now you spell. Listen to the word, then build it with the letters.

entrance.passage.text: Last one! Read this little story out loud.

entrance.done.text: You finished the Entrance Quest! Hooray! Kitty is cheering for you.

check.welcome.text: Today is Read to Kitty day! Kitty loves to hear you read. Let's read to Kitty.

check.passage.text: Last one! Read Kitty this little story, in your best story voice.

check.done.text: Kitty had the best time. Thank you for reading to Kitty!

reward.gift.text: You finished today's adventure! Here is a gift for you.

reward.choose.text: Pick one gift. The other one will still be here another day.

reward.colorin.text: And a new page for your coloring book!

reward.change.text: Tap a picture to change your page.

reward.trick.text: Your trick bag is filling up!

reward.charm.text: Your bracelet has a new charm!

reward.home.text: Click the door to go back to the castle.

reward.surprise.text: Surprise! A little something extra, just because.

close.idea.2.text: Find three things at home that start with the shh sound, like ship.

close.idea.3.text: Tell your grown-up what Queen Vex did today.

close.idea.4.text: Find three things at home that start with the mmm sound, like moon.

close.idea.5.text: Read a book to your stuffed animals before bed.

close.idea.6.text: Look for short words you can read on boxes and signs.

break.start.text: Wiggle break! Stand up and move with Kitty.

break.ballet.1.text: Stand tall like a ballet dancer. Make a circle with your arms over your head.

break.ballet.2.text: Rise up on your tiptoes, and slowly come down.

break.ballet.3.text: Point one toe. Now point the other toe.

break.ballet.4.text: Now a slow twirl, all the way around.

break.jumps.2.text: Two little hops, then one big jump!

break.jumps.3.text: Jump up and touch the sky!

break.swim.1.text: Let's swim! Reach your arms out in front, and stroke, stroke, stroke.

break.swim.2.text: Now kick your legs like a frog.

break.swim.4.text: Take a big, slow breath, like you're floating.

break.stretch.start.text: Stretch break! Stand up and stretch with Kitty.

break.stretch.1.text: Reach your paws up high, as high as they can go.

break.stretch.2.text: Now bend down, and touch your toes.

break.stretch.3.text: Put your paws on your knees, and round your back like a cat.

break.stretch.4.text: Give a big cat yawn, and shake out your tail.

break.parade.start.text: Parade break! Stand up and march with Kitty.

break.parade.1.text: March in place, with your knees up high.

break.parade.2.text: Wave to the crowd with one paw. Now wave with the other paw.

break.parade.3.text: Hold your crown on, and turn all the way around.

break.parade.4.text: Stand tall like a princess, and take a slow, deep breath.
break.parade.4.prince: Stand tall like a prince, and take a slow, deep breath.

break.done.text: Ahh. All stretched out! Back to the magic.

break.cuddle.text: Let's give Kitty a cuddle. Ahh. Nice and cozy.

break.cuddle.done.text: All better. Let's do an easy one together.

pass.how.text: Not sure? You can click Pass, and we'll come back to it later.

pass.back.text: Let's look at the ones we saved for later.

dressup.start.text: Welcome to the dress-up room! Click anything to try it on.

colorin.start.text: Pick a crayon, then click part of the picture to color it.

colorin.empty.text: Your coloring book is waiting for its first page. Pages come with the story!

copilot.turn.text: Grown-up's turn: did she read it?
copilot.turn.prince: Grown-up's turn: did he read it?

copilot.turn.said.text: Grown-up's turn: did she say it?
copilot.turn.said.prince: Grown-up's turn: did he say it?

copilot.readto.text: Read it out loud to your grown-up.

copilot.wait.text: Grown-up: wait five seconds before helping.

copilot.hint.text: Grown-up: instead of saying the word, try saying, check each sound.

copilot.rule.text: Grown-up: count it if she read the right word.
copilot.rule.prince: Grown-up: count it when he reads the right word.

copilot.timing.text: Grown-up: click start when she begins reading, and done when she finishes.
copilot.timing.prince: Grown-up: click start when he begins reading, and done when he finishes.

copilot.th.text: Grown-up: this is a made-up word, so either th sound is right.

copilot.pencil.text: Grown-up: judge only where the pencil starts and which way it goes, never neatness, size or speed. Watch the first stroke. Three good letters beat a page of them.

copilot.sh.text: Grown-up: she may say 'sip' for ship. Count it if she read the right word.
copilot.sh.prince: Grown-up: he may say 'sip' for ship. Count it if he read the right word.

selfcheck.read.text: Did you read it? Click 'I read it!' or 'Let me hear it.'

selfcheck.said.text: Did you say it? Click 'I said it!' or 'Let me try again.'

error.tricky.text: That's a tricky one we haven't practiced much yet.

error.reveal.text: Here it is. Click the glowing one.

error.later.text: We'll practice that one again soon.

praise.blend.1.text: You tapped each sound and slid them together — that's what readers do.

praise.blend.2.text: You stretched the sounds out, and the word popped right out.

praise.blend.3.text: You kept the sounds smooth and connected, like a slide.

praise.sound.1.text: You listened all the way to the last sound.

praise.sound.2.text: You heard the middle sound. That's the sneaky one.

praise.sound.3.text: You matched the sound to its letters.

praise.count.1.text: You counted every sound, one paw at a time.

praise.count.2.text: One box for each sound. You set them up just right.

praise.build.1.text: You built it left to right, sound by sound.

praise.build.2.text: You checked each box before you moved on.

praise.build.3.text: Two letters, one sound, one box. You spotted that team.

praise.read.1.text: You looked at every letter before you said the word.

praise.read.2.text: You read it all the way through, from start to end.

praise.read.3.text: You checked the vowel carefully. That's the tricky part.

praise.fix.1.text: You went back and fixed it yourself. Careful readers do that.

praise.fix.2.text: You noticed it didn't sound right, and you checked.

praise.chain.1.text: You changed just one sound, and made a brand-new word.

praise.chain.2.text: You found exactly which sound had to change.

praise.charm.1.text: You remembered the heart part. That's how charms stick.

praise.charm.2.text: You said each letter as it lit up.

praise.story.1.text: You read the whole line, and your words made the magic happen.

praise.story.3.text: You kept your place, word by word.

praise.effort.1.text: You kept going on a tricky one. That's how reading gets easier.

praise.effort.2.text: You took your time and looked closely.

praise.kitten.1.text: You helped Kitty find her mix-up. You knew just where to look.

kitten.protege.try.text: Ooh, let me try one! I made this word spell all by myself.

kitten.protege.ask.text: Is this right? I'm not sure…

kitten.protege.fix.text: Can you find my mix-up? Click the part to fix.

kitten.protege.gap.text: Can you find my mix-up? I think I left out a sound. Click the space where it goes.

kitten.protege.again.text: Hmm, is that the part? Let's look again, sound by sound.

kitten.protege.thanks.text: Oh! Thank you! Now I know it. I'll remember.

story.prologue-1.intro.1.text: Welcome to Whisker Academy, Princess! This castle is a school for magic, and today is your very first day.
story.prologue-1.intro.1.prince: Welcome to Whisker Academy, Prince! This castle is a school for magic, and today is your very first day.

story.prologue-1.intro.2.text: Here is the secret every student learns: at Whisker Academy, every spell is a word. When you read a word out loud, its magic comes alive.

story.prologue-1.intro.3.text: You already finished the Entrance Quest, the reading walk every new student takes. Now let's get you inside.

story.prologue-1.outro.1.text: Your map glows, and a twinkly path appears across it, leading straight through the castle doors.

story.prologue-1.outro.2.text: Look at that. You read four lines, and the magic followed you. Welcome in, Princess.
story.prologue-1.outro.2.prince: Look at that. You read four lines, and the magic followed you. Welcome in, Prince.

story.prologue-2.intro.1.text: Every student at Whisker Academy gets a familiar: a magic animal friend who learns right beside them.

story.prologue-2.intro.2.text: Out on the lawn, something is wiggling. And mewing!

story.prologue-2.outro.1.text: Kitty purrs and climbs right into your arms. Now she is your very own familiar.

story.prologue-2.outro.2.text: Kitty learns fast, but sometimes she mixes up words. When that happens, you'll be the expert who helps her.

story.prologue-3.intro.1.text: Your first class is in the Spell Workshop. Today's lesson: read a word, and it happens.

story.prologue-3.intro.2.text: You read a word, and poof! The very thing it names appears.

story.prologue-3.intro.3.text: Just then, the doors bang open. In sweeps Queen Vex, with a crown much too big for her head, and her crow, Gus, swooping behind her. 'Out of my way!' she sings. 'Bow to the grandest queen in the land!'

story.prologue-3.outro.1.text: 'Oh, bother my buttons!' Queen Vex slides across the floor and lands on her royal bottom. 'Caw! Caw! Oops!' says Gus.

story.prologue-3.outro.2.text: Queen Vex stomps away with her crown on sideways. And now you know the secret: your reading made that mop appear. Words really are spells.

story.prologue-3.question.text: Who slipped on the mop? Click the picture.

story.prologue-4.intro.1.text: After class, Kitty pads down the hall, and you follow her into the castle toy room.

story.prologue-4.intro.2.text: Two toys live here: a teddy bear named Ted and a rag doll named Dot. When the grown-ups leave the room, the toys wake up!

story.prologue-4.intro.3.text: Ted looks a little nervous. He has a very important question for Dot.

story.prologue-4.outro.1.text: Inside Ted's little box are two tiny gold rings. Ted and Dot are getting married!

story.prologue-4.outro.2.text: 'Oh, my stuffing,' sighs Ted happily. 'A royal toy wedding! Will you help us keep the wedding safe, Princess?' Of course you will.
story.prologue-4.outro.2.prince: 'Oh, my stuffing,' sighs Ted happily. 'A royal toy wedding! Will you help us keep the wedding safe, Prince?' Of course you will.

story.prologue-5.intro.1.text: In the main hall, you meet a classmate named Bix. Bix's magic makes things float.

story.prologue-5.intro.2.text: Across the hall, another classmate, Chip, is making a ball bounce higher and higher. Chip's magic makes things bounce!

story.prologue-5.intro.3.text: 'Off we go!' says Bix. But someone is spying on you: Gus, peeking out from behind a curtain, listening for wedding secrets.

story.prologue-5.outro.1.text: Gus wriggles free and flaps away, but he heard everything. He zooms off to tell Queen Vex.

story.prologue-5.outro.2.text: 'A wedding?' gasps Queen Vex. 'With two shiny gold rings? Those rings would look much better on me!'

story.prologue-5.question.text: Who got caught in the net? Click the picture.

story.prologue-6.intro.1.text: That night, the castle is quiet. Too quiet. Tiptoe, tiptoe… Queen Vex is sneaking toward the toy room, with Gus right behind her.

story.prologue-6.intro.2.text: The grown-ups are all asleep, so it's up to you, Princess. Bix and Kitty are ready. Read the tricks to set them!
story.prologue-6.intro.2.prince: The grown-ups are all asleep, so it's up to you, Prince. Bix and Kitty are ready. Read the tricks to set them!

story.prologue-6.outro.1.text: Sticky with jam and blown about by the fan, Queen Vex huffs away. 'This isn't over!' she calls. 'I will get those rings!'

story.prologue-6.outro.2.text: Ted and Dot's rings are safe, for now. On your very first day, your words saved the wedding.

story.prologue-side-1.intro.1.text: Free-time high jinks! It rained this morning, and the castle garden is soggy and squishy.

story.prologue-side-1.intro.2.text: Bix wants to make the gooiest pie ever. And look who's strolling by, admiring herself in her mirror…

story.prologue-side-1.outro.1.text: Squelch! Queen Vex steps right into the mud pie. 'Oh, bother my buttons!' She stomps away, leaving muddy footprints all down the hall.

story.prologue-side-1.outro.2.text: Bix laughs so hard he floats a little.

story.prologue-side-2.intro.1.text: Free-time high jinks! You're out in the garden, looking for critters.

story.prologue-side-2.intro.2.text: Something shiny is crawling about. Uh-oh. Gus loves anything shiny.

story.prologue-side-2.outro.1.text: Zip! The little bug buzzes away, and Gus tumbles beak-first into the leaves. 'Caw! Caw! Oops!'

story.prologue-side-3.intro.1.text: Free-time high jinks! Someone strange is sneaking to the toy room. Someone with bright orange curls… and a beak?

story.prologue-side-3.outro.1.text: Whoosh! The wig flies off, and there's Gus, blinking. He wanted to sneak in dressed up as Queen Vex. Nice try, Gus!

story.prologue-side-4.intro.1.text: Free-time high jinks! Kitty is dozing in a warm, bright spot on the lawn, with something over her eyes.

story.prologue-side-4.intro.2.text: Bix grins. He has a silly idea.

story.prologue-side-4.outro.1.text: Kitty wakes up and chases the floating hat all around the garden. Mew! Mew! It's the best game ever.

story.prologue-side-5.intro.1.text: Free-time high jinks! In the toy room, Ted and Dot are playing a game.

story.prologue-side-5.intro.2.text: Ted counts to ten. Ready or not, here he comes!

story.prologue-side-5.outro.1.text: Kitty found her! Dot pops out of the box, giggling, and gives Kitty a scratch behind the ears.

story.prologue-side-6.intro.1.text: Free-time high jinks! Queen Vex has dropped her crown in the castle pond, so she sends Gus to find her something else to wear on her head.

story.prologue-side-6.outro.1.text: Clang! Queen Vex peeks out from under the pot. 'Gus,' she sighs, 'a queen needs a crown, not a cooking pot.' Gus flaps off to try again.

story.ch1-1.intro.1.text: Chapter One: The Missing Rings. The whole castle is busy with wedding plans. Ted goes to check on the rings…

story.ch1-1.intro.3.text: Today you'll use a new spell pattern: the FLOSS rule. When a short word ends with f, l, s or z right after its vowel, that letter usually comes in a pair, like puff, bell, kiss and fuzz.

story.ch1-1.outro.1.text: In the middle of the mess lies one blue-gray feather. One of Gus's feathers! And where Gus goes, Queen Vex is never far behind.

story.ch1-1.outro.2.text: 'Don't worry, Ted,' says Dot, straightening his bow tie. 'Our friends will find them.'

story.ch1-2.intro.1.text: In the main hall, a girl with two puffy buns is practicing her magic. This is Tess. Tess's magic makes things shrink!

story.ch1-2.intro.2.text: And crawling right behind her, blowing bubbles, is her baby sister, Nell. Baby Nell sneaks into everything.

story.ch1-2.outro.1.text: 'Teeny-tiny time!' says Tess, holding up a bell no bigger than a button. 'I can help you find those rings.' Tess is on the team!

story.ch1-2.question.text: What did Tess shrink? Click the picture.

story.ch1-3.intro.1.text: Your team starts searching for clues. Look closely: something small and blue-gray. Gus has been here!

story.ch1-3.outro.1.text: The puff of wind carries the fluff down the hall and right under the kitchen door. The trail leads to the kitchen!

story.ch1-4.intro.1.text: Queen Vex is tiptoeing around the kitchen, quiet as a mouse. But Tess has a sneaky plan to keep track of her!

story.ch1-4.outro.1.text: Jingle, jingle! Now everyone can hear exactly where Queen Vex goes. And while she sits in the spill, Gus snatches something shiny from her pocket and darts off to hide.

story.ch1-5.intro.1.text: Gus is tucked in a basket of pom-poms, the ones Dot made for the wedding. And he's holding one of the rings!

story.ch1-5.outro.1.text: Ah… ah… ah-choo! Gus sneezes so hard that the ring flies out of his beak. One ring is back!

story.ch1-5.outro.2.text: But where is the other ring? Queen Vex still has it, and she's running outside!

story.ch1-5.question.text: Where did the ring land? Click the picture.

story.ch1-6.intro.1.text: Outside, Queen Vex reaches high on the castle wall, giggling. 'No one will ever look up here!'

story.ch1-6.outro.1.text: Queen Vex sits in the grass with the nest on her head, like a very messy hat. And the gull flies off over the castle, with the gold ring in its beak.

story.ch1-6.question.text: Who took the ring from the nest? Click the picture.

story.ch1-7.intro.1.text: You all chase the bird across the castle grounds, as fast as you can.

story.ch1-7.intro.2.text: And who has crawled all the way out here? Baby Nell, of course.

story.ch1-7.outro.1.text: Baby Nell's biggest bubble floats up out of the well, with the gold ring inside it! Pop! The ring drops right into Tess's hands.

story.ch1-7.outro.2.text: Nell doesn't even know she saved the day. She just giggles and claps.

story.ch1-8.intro.1.text: Back in the toy room, you hand both rings to Ted. Safe and sound!

story.ch1-8.outro.1.text: The wedding is on! Ted and Dot thank you and your friends with the biggest toy-room hug ever.

story.ch1-8.outro.2.text: But far away in her tower, Queen Vex peeks into her hand mirror. 'Fine, keep your rings,' she mutters. 'But every wedding needs a cake…' Gus's tummy rumbles.

story.ch2-1.intro.1.text: Chapter Two: The Cake Caper. In the castle kitchen, the cooks have just finished the wedding cake. It is even taller than Ted!

story.ch2-1.intro.2.text: New pattern: c-k. At the end of a short word, c and k team up to make one sound, like in sock, lock and quack.

story.ch2-1.intro.3.text: One more thing. The word cake uses a spelling pattern you'll learn later on, so in your lines today, the cake is called it. When you read it, think cake!

story.ch2-1.outro.1.text: 'Every wedding needs a cake,' says Dot, 'and this one is perfect.'

story.ch2-1.outro.2.text: But outside the window, a round blue-gray head pops up. Gus's tummy rumbles. Uh-oh.

story.ch2-2.intro.1.text: That night, Dot locks the cake in the pantry, safe and sound. Tick, tock. Everyone is asleep.

story.ch2-2.intro.2.text: Then, tiptoe, tiptoe. Who comes creeping in?

story.ch2-2.outro.1.text: Bump, bump, bump. Gus drags the sack away, with Queen Vex pushing from behind. 'Caw! Caw! Oops!'

story.ch2-2.question.text: What did Gus put the cake in? Click the picture.

story.ch2-3.intro.1.text: Morning. Ted opens the pantry, and the cake is gone! 'Oh, my stuffing!'

story.ch2-3.intro.2.text: But last night, Gus walked right through the soot by the fireplace. Look closely at the floor.

story.ch2-3.outro.1.text: The black tracks climb all the way up to Queen Vex's tower. She plans to eat the whole cake herself, at midnight!

story.ch2-4.intro.1.text: In the Spell Workshop, Tess has a sneaky idea. 'We'll make a pretend cake!'

story.ch2-4.intro.2.text: A good trick has one rule: never let Queen Vex know what is coming.

story.ch2-4.outro.1.text: A coat of white icing, a cherry on top, and it looks just like the real cake. Nobody would ever guess it is socks.

story.ch2-5.intro.1.text: Socks make no sound at all. So everyone pulls socks on over their shoes and creeps up the tower stairs.

story.ch2-5.intro.2.text: Queen Vex is snoring on her throne, right next to the cake.

story.ch2-5.outro.1.text: 'Teeny-tiny time!' The real cake, now as small as a button, rides home in Tess's pocket. The sock cake stays behind, looking very tasty.

story.ch2-6.intro.1.text: Midnight in the tower. Queen Vex tucks in her napkin and picks up her very biggest fork.

story.ch2-6.intro.2.text: 'All mine,' she sings. 'Bow to the grandest queen in the land!'

story.ch2-6.outro.1.text: 'Oh, bother my buttons!' Queen Vex pulls a long striped sock out of her mouth. 'Caw! Caw! Oops!' says Gus, who rather likes his rock.

story.ch2-6.outro.2.text: Back in the kitchen, Tess taps the tiny cake, and it grows and grows until it is taller than Ted. Safe!

story.ch2-6.outro.3.text: But Queen Vex is already peering down at the toy room. 'Fine. Keep your cake. That dress would look much better on me.'

story.ch2-6.question.text: What did Queen Vex bite? Click the picture.

story.ch2-side-1.intro.1.text: Free-time high jinks! Baby Nell has found the pile of socks left over from the sock cake.

story.ch2-side-1.outro.1.text: Out pops Kitty, and Nell laughs until she gets the hiccups.

story.ch2-side-2.intro.1.text: Free-time high jinks! Bix floats a sock down the hall, just over Gus's head. 'Up you go!'

story.ch2-side-2.outro.1.text: Gus flaps around in a circle. A sock on the head does funny things to a crow. 'Quack! I mean, caw!'

story.ch3-1.intro.1.text: Chapter Three: Into the Carriage. Dot's wedding dress is finished at last, with a long silky sash. It is beautiful.

story.ch3-1.intro.2.text: New pattern: s-h. When s and h team up, they make one quiet sound, the one at the start of ship and at the end of fish.

story.ch3-1.outro.1.text: Down the stairs they run, out to the royal carriage. Queen Vex never says carriage. She calls it her cab.

story.ch3-1.outro.2.text: So when you read cab, think carriage!

story.ch3-2.intro.1.text: Tess turns around. Where is her baby sister? One tiny bubble floats out of the carriage window.

story.ch3-2.outro.1.text: Not one grown-up looks up. It's up to you!

story.ch3-2.question.text: Who is hiding in the carriage? Click the picture.

story.ch3-3.intro.1.text: 'Up you go!' says Bix, and his magic floats you onto the back of the carriage. It rattles all the way down to the sea.

story.ch3-3.outro.1.text: A purple ship with golden sails, and a statue of Queen Vex at the front. Naturally.

story.ch3-4.intro.1.text: Down below the deck, it's warm and quiet and it smells of fish. On a coil of rope, somebody opens one green eye.

story.ch3-4.intro.2.text: It's a thin spotted cat in a sailor collar. Her name tag says Dash. Nobody on this ship ever says hello to her.

story.ch3-4.outro.1.text: Dash purrs for the first time all year. Kitty purrs right back.

story.ch3-4.outro.2.text: And Dash knows every corner of this ship, Princess. She knows just where Queen Vex hid the dress.
story.ch3-4.outro.2.prince: And Dash knows every corner of this ship, Prince. She knows just where Queen Vex hid the dress.

story.ch3-4.question.text: Who is your new friend? Click the picture.

story.ch3-5.intro.1.text: Up on deck, Queen Vex is strutting about in Dot's dress. It does not fit her one bit.

story.ch3-5.intro.2.text: Dash leads you to the ship's kitchen, where there is a big pot of mashed potato. Time for a trick!

story.ch3-5.outro.1.text: Down she goes, into a barrel of fish! 'Oh, bother my buttons!' The dress flies off, flutters over the rail and floats away.

story.ch3-6.intro.1.text: The dress drifts down, down, down. And who is sitting in a little rowboat, right where it lands? Baby Nell!

story.ch3-6.outro.1.text: Home you swim, with Nell and the dress safe in a big bubble, and Dash riding on your back. Dot gives you the biggest hug.

story.ch3-6.outro.2.text: Far behind, Queen Vex picks a fish out of her curls. 'No wedding can start until the castle bells ring,' she mutters. 'And I still have all those socks.'

story.ch3-side-1.intro.1.text: Free-time high jinks! Dash lives at the castle now. She and Kitty follow their noses all the way to the kitchen.

story.ch3-side-1.outro.1.text: Gus drops the dish, and the two cats share the fish. Nobody tells the cook.

story.ch3-side-2.intro.1.text: Free-time high jinks! Down on the shore by the ship, Tess sets up a little shop of seashells.

story.ch3-side-2.outro.1.text: The bug rides on her crown all the way down the beach. Bow to the grandest bug in the land.

story.ch4-1.intro.1.text: Chapter Four: The Silent Bells. No wedding can start until the castle bells ring. So up you go, to the very top of the bell tower.

story.ch4-1.intro.2.text: New pattern: t-h, the buzzing kind, as in this and that.

story.ch4-1.outro.1.text: Clunk. Clunk. Clunk. Not one single note. Something must be stuck inside those bells.

story.ch4-2.intro.1.text: You poke your head inside the biggest bell. Pee-yew! It smells like feet.

story.ch4-2.outro.1.text: All the socks from the sock cake, jammed in tight! Queen Vex saved every single one in a sack, just for this.

story.ch4-2.question.text: What is stuck in the bell? Click the picture.

story.ch4-3.intro.1.text: Back in the toy room, Ted and Dot hear the news. 'No bells? Oh, my stuffing.'

story.ch4-3.outro.1.text: 'Our friends will find a way,' says Dot, and she smiles right at you. Ted straightens his bow tie. He feels better already.

story.ch4-4.intro.1.text: Back to the Spell Workshop, for the big old book of little helpers. Bix flips the pages. Frogs? No. Bees? No.

story.ch4-4.outro.1.text: A whole page of fuzzy little moths! Moths love to nibble wool socks. Now, where can you find some moths?

story.ch4-5.intro.1.text: Evening falls on the path to the bell tower. And moths love a bright light.

story.ch4-5.intro.2.text: New pattern: t-h, the whispery kind, as in thin and moth. The same two letters, with a softer sound.

story.ch4-5.outro.1.text: 'Up you go!' Bix floats the lamp up the tower, and the moths follow it like a fuzzy little cloud.

story.ch4-5.question.text: What did the moths follow? Click the picture.

story.ch4-6.intro.1.text: Nibble, nibble, nibble. The moths get to work on Queen Vex's socks.

story.ch4-6.intro.2.text: And up on the top beam lives the biggest, sleepiest cat in the castle. The bell ringers named her Thud. You'll see why.

story.ch4-6.outro.1.text: Down comes the big bell with a cat on top, and out shoots the last sock. Pop!

story.ch4-6.outro.2.text: Bong! The first note in days rolls out over the castle. Thud yawns, and goes back to sleep on the bell.

story.ch4-7.intro.1.text: Meanwhile, Queen Vex is having a victory bubble bath, right under the bell tower. 'No bells, no wedding,' she hums.

story.ch4-7.outro.1.text: 'Oh, bother my buttons!' Soggy socks and sleepy moths everywhere. The bells ring out again, and Thud stays on as the castle's bell cat.

story.ch4-7.outro.2.text: The moths flutter down to say thank you, and they leave a gift for Kitty: a pair of moth wings, just her size!

story.ch4-7.outro.3.text: Queen Vex wrings out a sock and thinks very hard. The wedding lunch, she thinks. Hmm.

story.ch4-7.question.text: What fell on Queen Vex? Click the picture.

story.ch4-side-1.intro.1.text: Free-time high jinks! It is Baby Nell's bath night, and Kitty came to watch. A little too closely.

story.ch4-side-1.outro.1.text: A small round ball of bubbles runs down the hall. Somewhere inside it is Kitty.

story.ch4-side-2.intro.1.text: Free-time high jinks! Thud has found the very last sock. And so has Gus.

story.ch4-side-2.outro.1.text: Thud curls up on the sock and goes straight to sleep. Gus decides he didn't want it anyway.

story.ch5-1.intro.1.text: Chapter Five: Chip's Chase. Remember Chip, your classmate whose magic makes things bounce? Here he comes now!

story.ch5-1.intro.2.text: New pattern: c-h, as in chip and chin. And now you can read his name!

story.ch5-1.outro.1.text: Boing! Chip bounces off down the hall, laughing. 'Count me in!' Chip is on the team.

story.ch5-2.intro.1.text: The wedding lunch, for a hundred hungry toys, is nearly ready. The cooks are so busy they never look up.

story.ch5-2.outro.1.text: But outside, a hand with a very big ring on it quietly opens the henhouse door. Uh-oh.

story.ch5-3.intro.1.text: In tiptoes Queen Vex, carrying a box. A box that goes peep.

story.ch5-3.outro.1.text: Peep, peep, peep! Fluffy yellow chicks in every pot and pan. 'Bow to the grandest queen in the land!' cackles Queen Vex, and off she runs.

story.ch5-3.question.text: What was in the box? Click the picture.

story.ch5-4.intro.1.text: After them! Over the pots, under the table, round and round the cook, who still thinks it is a nice quiet day.

story.ch5-4.outro.1.text: Back into the box they go, one fluffy chick at a time. All but one.

story.ch5-5.intro.1.text: One chick got away. It hopped across the floor, looking for somewhere warm.

story.ch5-5.intro.2.text: It found somewhere warm. It found Gus.

story.ch5-5.outro.1.text: Nobody has ever hugged Gus before. He goes very quiet. 'Caw,' he says softly. 'Oops.'

story.ch5-5.outro.2.text: And when Queen Vex calls for him, he doesn't flap away. He has a chick to look after.

story.ch5-5.question.text: Who sat on Gus? Click the picture.

story.ch5-6.intro.1.text: Queen Vex comes sneaking back for one more go at the lunch. But Chip has left his ball on the step. On purpose.

story.ch5-6.outro.1.text: She peeks out of the flour chest, white from her crown to her toes. 'Gus!' she calls. But Gus does not come.

story.ch5-6.outro.2.text: 'Fine,' says Queen Vex, very quietly. 'If I cannot stop the wedding, I will BE the bride.'

story.ch5-side-1.intro.1.text: Free-time high jinks! Chip and Bix invent a bouncing game. Baby Nell invents a better one.

story.ch5-side-1.outro.1.text: Game over. Nell wins, and she is not giving it back.

story.ch5-side-2.intro.1.text: Free-time high jinks! Kitty left her wizard hat out on the garden path. Something inside it is wriggling.

story.ch5-side-2.outro.1.text: Purr. Peep. Purr. Peep. Nobody has the heart to wake them.

story.ch6-1.intro.1.text: Chapter Six: The Wedding Crash. The big day is very close now. And here comes Gus, with his chick riding on his back.

story.ch6-1.intro.2.text: Today's lines mix every two-letter team you know: c-k, s-h, t-h and c-h.

story.ch6-1.intro.3.text: And one new word: wed. To wed is to get married.

story.ch6-1.outro.1.text: Gus used to tell Queen Vex everything. Today, he tells you. Her plan: a mint-green yarn wig, a very big polka-dot dress, and Queen Vex will pretend to be Dot!

story.ch6-2.intro.1.text: Into the great hall you go, with your trick bag. Every trick you have ever read is in there.

story.ch6-2.outro.1.text: A whole hall full of tricks, set from one end to the other. Whatever you do, don't step on that mop.

story.ch6-3.intro.1.text: Bix takes the fan. Gus takes the net. And the cats take the highest shelf, because cats always do.

story.ch6-3.outro.1.text: Tiptoe, tiptoe. Places, everyone. The wedding is about to begin.

story.ch6-3.question.text: Who has the net now? Click the picture.

story.ch6-4.intro.1.text: The wedding hall is full of toys in their very best clothes. Up at the front stands a small stuffed elephant with a big book. His name is Phil.

story.ch6-4.intro.2.text: New patterns: w-h, as in when, and p-h, as in Phil.

story.ch6-4.outro.1.text: The doors swing open. Someone in a very big dress comes slowly up the aisle.

story.ch6-5.intro.1.text: Up the aisle comes the bride, in a very big polka-dot dress. She is rather tall. And rather orange at the edges.

story.ch6-5.intro.2.text: Every toy in the hall goes 'Aww.' Every toy but one.

story.ch6-5.outro.1.text: 'Oh, my stuffing!' says Ted. 'You're not my Dot!' He would know his Dot anywhere. A wig can't fool love.

story.ch6-5.outro.2.text: 'Bow to the grandest bride in the land!' sings Queen Vex, and she runs for the door. Now, Princess! Your trick bag is ready.
story.ch6-5.outro.2.prince: 'Bow to the grandest bride in the land!' sings Queen Vex, and she runs for the door. Now, Prince! Your trick bag is ready.

story.ch6-5.question.text: Who is under the wig? Click the picture.

story.ch6-6.intro.1.text: Read the tricks, Princess. One line, one trick!
story.ch6-6.intro.1.prince: Read the tricks, Prince. One line, one trick!

story.ch6-6.intro.2.text: Queen Vex is running down the hall, straight toward the first one.

story.ch6-6.outro.1.text: Off flies the wig, and out spring the bright orange curls. Every toy gasps. It's Queen Vex!

story.ch6-7.intro.1.text: Queen Vex scrambles for the door. Keep reading!

story.ch6-7.outro.1.text: In the doorway stands the real Dot, in the very dress you saved. 'Caw! Caw! Oops!' says Gus, who is not sorry at all.

story.ch6-7.outro.2.text: Queen Vex sits in the net, sticky with jam, and for once she has nothing grand to say.

story.ch6-side-1.intro.1.text: Free-time high jinks! It's bell practice, and the bell cat will not come down. Chip has an idea.

story.ch6-side-1.outro.1.text: Nobody has ever seen Thud run before. Nobody will believe it.

story.ch6-side-2.intro.1.text: Free-time high jinks! Phil is helping in the kitchen. And so is Baby Nell.

story.ch6-side-2.outro.1.text: Phil looks very wise, and very sticky.

story.finale-1.intro.1.text: The Finale: The Wedding. At last, the big day! Pick the best thing in your wardrobe, Princess. Kitty is waiting.
story.finale-1.intro.1.prince: The Finale: The Wedding. At last, the big day! Pick the best thing in your wardrobe, Prince. Kitty is waiting.

story.finale-1.outro.1.text: And a gift from Ted and Dot, for their guest of honor: a wedding outfit, just for you. All set. Kitty purrs. Time to go!

story.finale-2.intro.1.text: The toys all hush. Phil opens his big book. 'Oh, my stuffing,' whispers Ted, happily.

story.finale-2.outro.1.text: Two tiny gold rings. The very same rings you found.

story.finale-3.intro.1.text: Now for the castle bells, every one of them. Up in the tower, Thud takes a great big leap.

story.finale-3.outro.1.text: Bong, bong, bong! Bubbles and floating hearts fill the hall. And Baby Nell claps too, just one beat behind everyone else.

story.finale-4.intro.1.text: Out of the net rolls Queen Vex, sticky from her crown to her shoes. Nobody has saved her a plate.

story.finale-4.intro.2.text: The wedding cake goes by, and her nose twitches. She remembers the last cake she bit: the sock cake. Dot stops. Dot looks at her for a long moment. Dot is kind.

story.finale-4.outro.1.text: 'Oh, bother my buttons,' says Queen Vex, with her mouth full. 'This is the best cake in the land.'

story.finale-4.outro.2.text: And for once, she forgets to say she's the grandest. Love wins, Princess. Even against jam.
story.finale-4.outro.2.prince: And for once, she forgets to say she's the grandest. Love wins, Prince. Even against jam.

story.finale-4.question.text: What did Queen Vex get to eat? Click the picture.

story.finale-5.intro.1.text: The sun goes down over Whisker Academy. Ted and Dot have one more thing to say to you.

story.finale-5.outro.1.text: You read this whole story, Princess, sound by sound and word by word. Your words were the spells. Kitty is sleepy. Good night.
story.finale-5.outro.1.prince: You read this whole story, Prince, sound by sound and word by word. Your words were the spells. Kitty is sleepy. Good night.
